newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call quiet on reporting day, gilts firm.
newsitem.headline: Indian call quiet on reporting day, gilts firm.

text.p: Indian call money was inactive in early Friday trade, the fortnightly reporting day for banks, dealers said.
Banks do not borrow on reporting days since this increases reserve requirements for the next fortnight.
Dealers said three-day money was quoted in a 4.25-4.75 percent range, indicating call money will be around 6.0-6.5 percent on Saturday.
Dealers said prices of government securities were firm in opening quotes but they are not expected to rise much.
"Prices are already at a high level and sharp increases are unlikely in future," said a foreign bank dealer.
